messages:
aparna: quick flag  during a customer review we noticed the Optimize toolkit tuning doc still shows an old KV prefetch example and recommends a `sample_rate` field that runtime no longer respects. snippets failing in docs CI. can someone triage?

jess: thanks, filing a small docs PR is probably fastest. can you paste the CI failure?

samir: CI output: SnippetMismatchError: caching example expected 'prefetch: true' but runtime returns 'prefetch_hint: intensity'. also snippet-runner logged unknown config key 'sample_rate' when validating batching heuristics.

matt: runtime changed the caching API to accept a prefetch hint: `prefetch_hint: low|med|high` and merged sample_rate into `sequence_budget`. docs should show the mapping and a brief heuristic for choosing sequence_budget.

aparna: good. let's do a docs-only PR that: 1) updates the caching/snippets to use prefetch_hint, 2) replaces sample_rate with sequence_budget in examples and the optimize heuristics page, 3) adds a tiny migration table (before -> after) and 4) adds a grep CI check for the old keys `sample_rate` and `prefetch: true`. keep changes scoped to docs/optimize.

zoe: I can take the caching example and the small diagram that explains prefetch intensity tradeoffs. will add a one-paragraph note about latency vs token-cost.

jess: I'll update Java/Node/Python snippets to use the new API surface. examples:```java
// caching example - java
import com.redwood.optimize.cache.CacheHints;
CacheHints hints = CacheHints.builder().prefetchHint("high").build();
```
```js
// node
const { CacheHints } = require('@redwood/optimize/cache');
const hints = CacheHints.from({ prefetchHint: 'med' });
```

samir: batching heuristics update: replace `sample_rate: 0.1` with `sequence_budget: 512` and add explanatory comment: `# sequence_budget is per-request token budget used to form batches` in YAML snippets.

matt: also add a short recipe: "When latency is critical, reduce sequence_budget and set prefetch_hint to low; when throughput is primary, increase sequence_budget and prefetch_hint to high." simple bullets should help.

jess: opening PR 4710: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/4710  includes snippet updates (java/node/py), YAML replacement, migration table in docs/optimize/MIGRATE_PREFETCH.md, and a grep-based CI check to fail on legacy keys. running snippet-runner locally first.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (pending)  triggered by jess on branch fix/prefetch-sequencebudget.

zoe: small gotcha: the PNG in the prefetch tradeoffs section was linked via a relative path that breaks when the doc is rendered as part of the guide. I pushed a path fix and optimized the alt text.

samir: local snippet-runner revealed a spacing-sensitive fenced block in heuristics.md; I fixed the fence and normalized indentation.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (failed)  snippet-runner reported a mismatch in the caching example output: runtime's prefetch_hint accepts 'medium' not 'med'.

jess: easy fix, will standardize to 'low|medium|high' and update all snippets. also update the migration table to map old boolean/true-> 'high' and false-> 'low' with a note about conservative defaults.

matt: can we add a tiny unit in docs-ci that verifies prefetch_hint values are one of the three allowed tokens? small YAML linter. I'll add it to infra pipeline.

jess: pushed the enum normalization and reran CI. PR 4710 updated.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (pending)  snippet-runner and markdown lint queued.

qa-bot: Docs snippet-runner (running)  languages: java,node,py; path: docs/optimize.

aparna: if this passes, merge and then follow up with a short blurb in the Optimize release notes pointing to MIGRATE_PREFETCH.md. product should include the note in release highlights.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (success)  all snippet tests passed.

jess: merged PR 4710. added the migration doc and a one-line change in the Optimize README referencing the tradeoff diagram.

zoe: leaving a follow-up issue to audit archived guides for `sample_rate` usage and any images with broken paths. will batch the sweep into next sprint.

matt: I'll open infra PR to add the prefetch_hint enum linter and the grep checks to the central docs pipeline next week.

aparna: thanks all. small win  this should prevent customer confusion when tuning KV prefetch vs sequence_budget. closing the thread unless someone wants to flag something else.

samir: quick note: added a short QA test case in tools/snippet-checks that asserts example outputs still match small-run defaults; helps catch silent API changes.

jess: nice. thanks team :tada:
